decisions.reason: Turnaround management software builds directly on the firm's apron equipment and operations know-how, and its dedicated web page signals strategic commitment and enough capacity to interpret and improve it.
Apron connectivity links the firm's own hardware into its software suite, so it draws heavily on existing electrical and integration knowledge.

Revenue calculation and billing sits furthest from the firm's electrical engineering base, but it uses usage data the firm's equipment already generates, so it is kept as a suite component despite weaker absorptive fit.
Equipment monitoring relies on the firm's deep knowledge of its own apron devices, which lets it read field results and refine the software effectively.
Resource management complements the turnaround platform and draws on the firm's understanding of apron processes, though it is less central than the flagship product.
The safety alert service builds on sensor and guidance-system expertise relevant to apron safety, but as a service with only a brief web mention it carries somewhat more uncertainty.
